O.content: The blue segment from the 2021 vertex to the 2022 vertex is nearly horizontal, and the 2023 endpoint is only slightly lower than the 2022 vertex.

B.text: If the blue line encodes Production by year and a near-horizontal recent segment is sufficient to classify the output trend as stable, select the stability route.
B.conditions: Assumes recent 2021-2023 behavior, rather than the full-period endpoint or title, defines the route; no stability threshold is supplied.

O.content: The title literally reads “Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023.”

B.text: If the chart title is an authoritative descriptor of the output trend for the reviewed facility and period, and a title stating “Increasing Production” maps to the growth follow-up category, select the growth route.
B.conditions: Applies only if the title is intended to govern routing despite any conflicting plotted values.

O.content: The blue line begins at the vertex aligned with the 2018 tick and ends at the vertex aligned with the 2023 tick; the 2023 vertex is lower on the page than the 2018 vertex.
The vertical axis is labeled “Production,” with printed tick labels rising from 0 at the bottom through 3,000 higher on the page.

B.text: If the blue line encodes Production against the vertical axis, whose printed values increase upward, and the vertices aligned with the first and last year ticks represent 2018 and 2023, then a lower final vertex represents lower final production; if endpoint change defines the route, select decline.
B.conditions: Assumes the plotted series rather than the title is authoritative and that 2018-to-2023 endpoint change defines the trend.
